title: After activating Airport mode, xDrip+ does not receive any data.
body: I am using the latest release (2nd November) and after activating the airport mode, xDrip+ missed signal for more than 30 minutes even with the Airport mode disabled. I reinstalled the app, and tried the assistant to set up MiaoMiao, and it's stuck on the initial 2 readings. It's not receiving anything. It's also happening with the Tomato app, it does not receive any data.

comments.body: I have solved the problem. It was solved activing the Aiport mode again.
